content: When you decide to take admission at Bennett University, you are opting for one of the finest institutions in the country—one that is backed by the trust and peerless legacy of The Times Group. With a global outlook and a future-focused curriculum, Bennett University offers undergraduate, and select postgraduate, and doctoral programs across diverse disciplines, including Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Management, Law, Design, Applied Sciences, Media, and Liberal Arts. To support your global aspirations, the university also offers Global Pathways and Three Country Programs in collaboration with renowned international universities. These initiatives enable students to begin their academic journey in India at Bennett University and complete it abroad earning a globally recognised degree. At Bennett University we select applicants to various programs through a merit-based process that combines several criteria, which may include performance in national examinations such as JEE, CUET and Board Examinations among others, as well as our own entrance tests such as BUDAT (design), BUMAT (management), BULAT (law) and Personal Interviews. Explore a wide range of programs available in Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and Global programs across various schools to discover the perfect fit for your aspirations.

content: Bennett University follows a structured, transparent, and merit-driven admission process designed to ensure fairness, efficiency, and a seamless experience for every applicant. Admissions are strictly based on academic merit and defined evaluation criteria, ensuring complete transparency at every stage. The University offers attractive academic and merit-based scholarships (first-cum-first-serve basis) to deserving and high-performing students. A comprehensive process from application to registration, ensuring individual attention. Admissions are assessed based on one or more of the following, as applicable to the program: Fill in online application form without waiting for the results Submit the scorecard once available to initiate selection process Update scores/marks in the application form immediately within 7 days of declaration of results: IB (DP/Certificate) Board predicted scores (received through counsellor)/ actual score, OR Passed XII standard from any recognised Education Board with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects & any other third subject with minimum 65% marks (Third subject should not be vocational- Music, Dance, Painting, Home Science, Arts, etc.) IB Board with minimum score of 24 credits, 3 Higher level and 3 standard level subjects. Meriting process will be done, and seats shall be allotted based on the choice of a program filled by the candidate at the application stage. The selected candidates shall be sent provisional admission offer letter along with important guidelines on registered e-mail ids. Payment of enrolment fee as per the date specified in provisional admission offer letter. Balance fee payment, document verification, registration will be done. Classes will commence by the first week of August/September 2025 (tentative). Guidelines for the same will be issued separately well in advance.
